exposure: Gestational diabetes diagnosed by IADPSG 2010 criteria
Gestational diabetes diagnosed by ADIPS 1998 criteria
cohort: 4081 pregnant women with positive 50 g glucose challenge test but without pre-gestational diabetes
finding: Women diagnosed with GDM by the IADPSG 2010 criteria but not the ADIPS 1998 criteria had an increased risk of LGA and primary cesarean section compared to women without GDM.
mod_finding: Women diagnosed with GDM by the IADPSG 2010 criteria but not the ADIPS 1998 criteria had an increased risk of primary cesarean section compared to women without GDM.
